answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 533 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nebula. The comet index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the karst queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. A 167 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
